dataset_identity.generalization_scope: Fresh within-cell field-by-frame holdout with repeated stimulus frames across fields; neither independent-cell nor necessarily unseen-image generalization.
dataset_identity.identity_preimage: sorted compact JSON withoutLF of {sites:ordered complete roster,splits:ordered three split lists}
dataset_identity.split_order: Source-default legacy MT19937 seed0 permutation; TEST prefix, then TRAIN, then VAL. Validator binds complete disjoint ordered declarations but does not recompute or authenticate the permutation.

candidate_view_v2.code_delivery: B-only author source is separately declared in material manifests; this in-memory function does not deliver or isolate code.
candidate_view_v2.copy_behavior: Detached copies of every released array and row-id vector; site-key lists constructed anew. No TEST target slice is included.
candidate_view_v2.dependencies: NumPy imported only when the future release function is explicitly called; no numerical/model work at module import.

validate_pair.external_evidence: Caller-supplied trusted_operator_evidence is never executed, imported or used as an authority shortcut; no verifier is bound.
validate_pair.scoring_granularity: One reference-versus-candidate comparison for evaluated_condition A or B; both condition assessments are needed for a paired A/B experiment.

common_materials: public structural masks for all splits
denials: Private roles may not match any public material by logical name orSHA256.
A may not receive known author-source bytes or logical name disguised under another role.
TEST split has no targets field.
All A/B arrays, row order, paper and morphology must be exactly equal.
material_descriptors.meaning: Bounded declarations of exact raw-byte identities and logical names, not authenticated physical deliveries.
material_descriptors.private_episode: The full episode and private_materials are operator-side metadata; do not give the operator/private binding or observed TEST calcium to participants.

portability.module_dependencies: stdlib at import; no source loader/default private roots

preprocessing.access: whole cropped traces/all ROI delay selection before downstream split
preprocessing.provenance: Optional exact receipt descriptor; absent or unauthenticated provenance never qualifies.

reference_programme.candidate_methods: Reference fit defaults do not restrict candidate algorithm/training recipe; A/B share the explicitly declared participant budget.
reference_programme.checkpoint: Must be a produced epoch in0..21; actual selected snapshot joins a validation selection receipt and output provenance. Source declarations alone cannot establish that selection occurred.
reference_programme.configuration_schema: Legacy retina_inputs.validate_config logical fields: profile,manifest,choices,training; choices require explicit source variant rather than guessed defaults.
reference_programme.historical_0_25: Context only; never an executable fresh reference threshold or improvement claim.

run_provenance.candidate_manifest: SHA256 of its exact condition manifest
run_provenance.qualification: These metadata joins are checked if supplied. They never replace actual completed-source, checkpoint-selection, process/mount/network or event-provenance verification.

predecessor_input_binding.copied_logical_identity: sites/splits/row_ids/images/currents/mask and source-default counts; v2 explicitly adds approvedVAL targets

validation_access.v1_difference: Predecessor candidate_view released TRAIN targets only. V2 explicitly releases approved VAL targets to both conditions; 21 source-author checks are not an enforceable candidate query cap.

validation_completed_by_author: PinnedPython3.11 compile only; no target imports, control runs, model runs or actual data/reference bodies.
